hooks.text: 采用九十年代末RPG式预渲染复古画面，把地狱群怪生存包装成老派暗黑视觉
hooks.excerpt: Halls of Torment is a horde survival game with a pre-rendered retro look reminiscent of RPGs from the late 90s.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 稀有物品可从地下送回地表并用于定制后续流程，把本局掉落转化为跨局Build资源
hooks.excerpt: Unique items can be sent up to the overworld and used to customize future runs
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 十一名角色、六十件基础物品与二百四十种高稀有变体，再叠加七十四项能力和一千多条Trait
hooks.excerpt: 11 playable characters & character marks 25 blessings that make you stronger for each run 60 unique items to retrieve and unlock 240 higher rarity item variants 74 abilities and ability upgrades 30 artifacts to customize your game experience 35+ unique bosses 70+ unique monsters 500 quests to complete 1000+ traits that upgrade characters and abilities
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
